choices.resultText: The keeper turns away, the lantern dimming along the road. The figures following it stop in front of you and draw their weapons.

choices.label: Accept the keeper's thanks (gain the Gravetender's Bell)
choices.resultText: A small bell, iron and cold, pressed into your palm. "One toll for each name," the keeper says. "You will know when."

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

events.name: The Second Cairn
events.text:
Beside the road stands a second cairn. Its swords have fallen into the mud; no names are carved on its stones.

The keeper is not here. The road continues beyond it, and you cannot tell which way the keeper went.

choices.label: Raise every sword and keep the vigil (upgrade 2 random cards)
choices.resultText: You raise every fallen sword and stand among them until the cinder-light gutters. The bell in your pack rings once, though nothing moved it. The stones remain unwritten.

choices.label: Raise every sword, then rest (heal 30% max HP)
choices.resultText: You set every sword upright before lying down among the stones. What you returned bought you this much: a night among the nameless, and no one waking you.

choices.label: Loot the barrow (gain 120 cinders, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: You drag the fallen swords aside and prise the cinders from beneath them. Second time is easier. You leave the blades in the mud; that is the part that follows you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

events.name: The Last Lantern
events.text:
An unmarked routekeeper braces a broken signal lantern against the rain. The drivers call this traveler the Road Warden; there is no Fell Courtyard crest on the coat.

"That caravan carries medicine to Lantern Haven and the cold hamlets beyond. Oil costs forty cinders. Or help me haul the spare beacon up the scree."

choices.label: Buy signal oil (pay 40 cinders; aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The wick catches. The Road Warden records forty cinders beside Lantern Haven in a weathered supply ledger.

choices.label: Haul the beacon (take 8 damage; aid the caravan)
choices.resultText: The iron frame cuts your palms, but its light clears the ridge. The Road Warden waves Lantern Haven’s wagons through and promises to remember the work.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You pass the unlit lantern. The caravan must find another way.

events.name: The Caravan Comes Through
events.text:
The Road Warden stands beside Lantern Haven’s mud-spattered wagons. The last one carries the lantern you helped raise.

"You bought these people a road. We can pay our debt. That strongbox is for medicine at the next trading post; it belongs to the cold hamlets."

choices.label: Accept the quartermaster’s lesson (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The quartermaster shows you the economy of a practiced motion. Your investment returns as knowledge.

choices.label: Accept wages for the climb (gain 60 cinders)
choices.resultText: The Road Warden counts out fair wages. The cuts on your hands have earned their keep.

choices.label: Steal the emergency strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons onward, asking nothing in return.

classes.name: Reaver
classes.description: Fights up close and switches footing mid-battle — one stance hits harder, the other holds the line. Wounds you land keep bleeding, and heavy blows stagger.

classes.name: Starseer
classes.description: Casts in sequence — the second spell each turn strikes harder than the first. Fragile early on, so the order you play cards matters more than their power.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Sets up a clean opening, then turns speed, poison, and opportunism into decisive strikes before the enemy can recover.

classes.name: Herald
classes.description: Spends its own health to act, then heals it back. Spreads a rot that damages enemies over time. One pool for everything, so mistakes stack up fast.

armaments.name: Straight Sword
armaments.blurb: Honest steel. It asks nothing clever of you.

armaments.name: Greatsword
armaments.blurb: Slow, and it does not care.

armaments.name: Dagger
armaments.blurb: Two cuts where one would do.

armaments.name: Shortbow
armaments.blurb: A compact ash-wood bow bound for a quick draw.

armaments.name: Katana
armaments.blurb: A long curve, and a long grudge.

armaments.name: Halberd
armaments.blurb: Reach enough to keep the dead at arm's length.

armaments.name: Warhammer
armaments.blurb: Poise is a fiction. This is the argument.

armaments.name: Twinblade
armaments.blurb: Both ends are the business end.

armaments.name: Battleaxe
armaments.blurb: It was a woodcutter's once.

armaments.name: Buckler
armaments.blurb: Small enough to be quick with.

armaments.name: Kite Shield
armaments.blurb: A wall you can carry. Your arm knows it.

armaments.name: Tower Shield
armaments.blurb: You will not be moved. You will not move.

armaments.name: Round Shield
armaments.blurb: Plain, round, and enough.

armaments.name: Spiked Shield
armaments.blurb: Defence with an opinion.

armaments.name: Lantern
armaments.blurb: Light enough to see what is coming.

armaments.name: Torch
armaments.blurb: Fire remembers what steel forgets.

armaments.name: Parrying Dagger
armaments.blurb: Held wrong on purpose.

armaments.name: Ash Staff
armaments.blurb: Grey wood, warm at the grip.

armaments.name: Starstone Staff
armaments.blurb: The stone hums before you do.

armaments.name: Bone Sceptre
armaments.blurb: Someone knelt for this once.

armaments.name: Emberlight Sceptre
armaments.blurb: It keeps a little of the guiding flame.

armaments.name: Goldbough Branch
armaments.blurb: Cut, and still growing.

armaments.name: Blight Rod
armaments.blurb: Wet to the touch. It should not be.

armaments.name: Gorefire Brand
armaments.blurb: Blood takes to flame more readily than wood.

armaments.name: Wyrmhorn Staff
armaments.blurb: Taken from something that objected.

armaments.name: Frost Spear
armaments.blurb: A rimed point that slows the next advance.

armaments.name: Cinder Axe
armaments.blurb: A furnace edge bought with a slower swing.

armaments.name: Dusk Chime

basicCardProfiles.flavor:
Blow of the empty fist.

The last thing a Forsaken owns once the blade is broken and the cairn has kept it. No hamlet teaches it; it is learned the first winter a sword is traded for salt.

A last resort, still yours.

Rim-blow of the Bastion's shield line.

Climbers learn it from salvaged Warden shields, once gilded with the branch. Most scrape the gold away. The corrupted Wardens of the Fell Courtyard hesitate at the sight of it.

Some leave the gold.

Plain cut of Bastion steel.

Drilled into the field levies and the sellswords hired beside them. Weald smiths never signed their blades, a custom the Chapel's scribes thought insolent and never ended.

Unsigned steel can be carried without anyone asking whose it was.

Turning flurry of the Citadel's midwinter masque.

Court dancers spun double-ended blades before the throne. Stitched to their posts when the Court Flame died, some turn yet upon the frozen river, slower each winter.

Climbers learn the step by watching. The dancers do not mind.

Two quick openings, as the Court's surgeons let a vein.

Their apprentices taught it on the docks once the Court stopped paying them. One teaches it yet, for cinders, beneath the ice below the Citadel.

He learned to open people. He taught himself to close them, and does not sell that part.

Shot loosed from low cover.

The way weald poachers took the deer the Bastion kept for its tables. The Bastion hanged poachers, so the hamlets loosed upon the dawn peal, which hid the sound of the string.

The Bell Keeper rings the peal yet, though no dawn follows.

Cold light struck from an apprentice's staff.

Cut green from weald lanternwood and tipped with starstone bought from the reach miners. The Starwatch taught that the light came from the stone.

It came more easily with the staff turned skyward. The apprentices were told not to notice.

Working of a cantor's sceptre.

Chapel sceptres bore script copied from sealstone doors older than the Chapel. The cantors were taught its sounds, never its sense. The Chapel called the script sacred.

Among themselves, the cantors called it borrowed.

Empty-handed guard of the ice-fishers.

Weight low, feet wide, upon lakes that crack all winter and hold but one at a time. The fishers of Sallow Lake say the ice has a temper, and may be reasoned with.

Those who said otherwise are beneath it.

Haft-turn of the Bastion's field levies.

Sergeant Ilse drilled it upon the Muster Stair. On quiet nights her voice carries from the Bastion walls, calling the count.

The levies she drilled are corrupted now. When they hear her, they take their places.

Shield set against the blow, as the Wardens taught.

Bastion shields bore strips of bell-bronze upon the rim, cast from metal left when the great bell was founded. The Wardens said the bronze rang the hour when struck.

It rings at other hours too.

Ward drawn through a staff, taught upon Starwatch Terrace.

Where the apprentices measured the new tower's draw across the water. The Astronomer said the ward was against the salt wind.

It leaned toward the Spire whenever it was drawn.

Ward of the bier-watch.

Cantors held a sceptre crosswise over the dead through the night, before a name was written. The Chapel taught that it kept the name from wandering.

Where a name might wander, the rubric does not say.

Art of the empty hand.

Mostly the art of not being where the blow lands, taught by the ship-breakers upon hulls that shift with the tide. Gull-Bet calls it the first thing the Forsaken ever had that the marked envied.

That has been true for a very short while.

A weapon learned as it was last used.

Take up what the corrupted drop, and let its habits show. A blade taken from a Warden cuts like a Warden. Orla of the hamlets below the Bastion bears a sword that dips toward the Fell Courtyard as she passes.

She no longer fights the pull.

The poacher's pause before loosing.

Breath out, hand set, wait for the bell. Weald poachers learned patience from the Bastion's gamekeepers, who hanged the impatient. The gamekeepers walk the lanternwood yet, among the corrupted.

They count beneath their breath. The count never ends.

Breath set behind the focus.

Counted to the rhythm of the star tables, recited until the rhythm lived in the breath. The Starwatch taught the tables were only numbers; the apprentices held the rhythm older.

On the night of the eclipse, the Astronomer read the last table aloud, and did not stop at its end.

survey:crownfall.title: The Empty Channel
survey:crownfall.description: Crownfall has more buckets than water. Survey the Old Aqueduct and return to the Road Warden; the cracked channel may still shelter a path.
survey:crownfall.report: The channel carries no water. Bootprints follow its bed. The Road Warden marks a path beside the empty buckets.

survey:bellhaven.title: A Road for the Uncounted
survey:bellhaven.description: Bellhaven shelters families once turned away at dusk. Survey the Old Aqueduct for a road they can walk, then return to the Road Warden.
survey:bellhaven.report: A broken toll gate lies across the channel. Footprints pass around it. The Road Warden crosses a fee out of the route-book.

survey:lantern-haven.title: A Spring That Will Not Turn
survey:lantern-haven.description: Lantern Haven needs a road through the growth. Survey the Drowned Hamlet and return to the Road Warden. The branches have flowered again; there is still no fruit.
survey:lantern-haven.report: Blossoms float through the drowned doorways. Beneath them lie last year's blossoms. The Road Warden leaves the harvest column blank.

survey:frostgate.title: Ice Without a Thaw
survey:frostgate.description: Frostgate's fishers need a path across the old winter road. Survey the Frozen Camp and return to the Road Warden. The thaw stakes have not moved in a generation.
survey:frostgate.report: Ice has swallowed the lashings on the camp's thaw stakes. The Road Warden draws the winter road again and puts away the spring map.

survey:emberhold.title: The Mountain Stirs
survey:emberhold.description: Emberhold's carriers found fresh cracks under their boots. Survey the Caldera Rim and return to the Road Warden before another cart takes that road.
survey:emberhold.report: A wheel-rut ends at a fresh split in the stone. Warm grit shakes from the rim. The Road Warden moves a route marker away from the edge.

survey:saltwatch.title: The High-Water Marks
survey:saltwatch.description: Saltwatch's ship-breakers count safe roads by the tide. Survey the Drowned Orchard and return to the Road Warden. The old water marks are below your feet.
survey:saltwatch.report: Salt has crusted the upper branches. A mooring ring hangs above a drowned doorway. The Road Warden turns the low-road marker face down.

nodes.name: Gate of Unkept Names
nodes.lore: Every name on this gate has been scratched out from within.

nodes.name: Rootbound Fork
nodes.lore: The paving divides around a root older than the wall. Both tracks carry fresh mud.

nodes.name: Pilgrims' Hollow
nodes.lore: Do not pull the thorns from your cloak. They are how she counts who leaves.

nodes.name: Broken Processional
nodes.lore: The stones are worn at the knees, not the feet.

nodes.name: Moss Stair
nodes.lore: Something beneath the moss breathes against the stair. A blight hound lifts its head.

nodes.name: Chapel of Small Mercies
nodes.lore: A gold cup stands beneath a roof that fell generations ago. It is still full.

nodes.name: Widow's Recess
nodes.lore: A child's wooden shoe rests beside an adult's stone effigy.

nodes.name: The Last Grave Tender
nodes.lore: I leave one grave open. If I fill it, I have to admit whom it was for.

nodes.name: Seed Reliquary
nodes.lore: The reliquary holds seeds wrapped in burial cloth, each labeled with a season.

nodes.name: Abandoned Watch Chapel
nodes.lore: A narrow window faces away from the forest and toward the great tree.

nodes.name: Bridge of Bound Vows
nodes.lore: State whom you have come to mourn. A blade is not an answer.

nodes.name: Waterward Fork
nodes.lore: A second road leaves the gate beside a channel cut into the rock.

nodes.name: Thorn Scribe
nodes.lore: I write the names she forgets. The bark heals faster each year.

nodes.name: Lower Stone Bridge
nodes.lore: A blight hound waits where the bridge narrows, its muzzle tangled in prayer cords.

nodes.name: Candleless Landing
nodes.lore: Wax fills every crack in the landing, but no wick remains.

nodes.name: East Chapel Steps
nodes.lore: A kneeling statue holds a bowl toward the waterfall.

nodes.name: Keeper of the Empty Bowl
nodes.lore: She took our hunger first. We thanked her. Then she took what we hungered for.

nodes.name: Waterfall Oratory
nodes.lore: A leather satchel hangs above the spray, protected by a curtain of thorns.

nodes.name: The Listening Hedge
nodes.lore: Speak softly. The leaves repeat whatever they hear to Mother.

nodes.name: Pilgrim's Turn
nodes.lore: Footprints circle a single root before joining the upper path.

nodes.name: Rear Watch Ruin
nodes.lore: A fallen bell lies stuffed with moss, its clapper deliberately removed.

nodes.name: The Unnamed Gardener
nodes.lore: She is not guarding the dead from you. She is guarding them from the morning.

nodes.name: Sanctum Stair
nodes.lore: Every root points inward. The stair rises into a silence that feels held shut.

nodes.name: Heart of Briar Sanctum
nodes.lore: I kept them. Every one. Would you have me call that a sin?

nodes.name: Gate of Second Faces
nodes.lore: Your reflection reaches the gate a moment before you do.

nodes.name: Winter Garden Fork
nodes.lore: The snow is broken by footsteps that never seem to leave.

nodes.name: The Unreflected Porter
nodes.lore: Leave your reflection with me. Guests must not bring strangers into court.

nodes.name: Fountain of Still Water
nodes.lore: The fountain is frozen around a falling drop.

nodes.name: Gardener of Glass
nodes.lore: The Regent wanted flowers that could not die. Glass was only the first attempt.

nodes.name: Shattered Conservatory
nodes.lore: The collapsed glasshouse shelters a box of ordinary earth.

nodes.name: Glasshouse Crossing
nodes.lore: Glass ribs make a cage around an empty planting bed.

nodes.name: Statue Walk
nodes.lore: A porcelain sentry turns its face to match yours.

nodes.name: The White Landing
nodes.lore: The same farewell is carved into every step in a different hand.

nodes.name: Bridge of Courtesy
nodes.lore: Bow to the image, never the guest. Images do not change their loyalties.

nodes.name: The Thawing Witness
nodes.lore: I saw the original die. Every morning since, another reflection has denied it.

nodes.name: Causeway Fork
nodes.lore: The other road crosses dark water on broad stone arches.

nodes.name: The Tarn Span
nodes.lore: A glass-armored sentinel drags its spear along the bridge rail.

nodes.name: Listening Balustrade
nodes.lore: Voices rise through the arches, repeating a conversation you have not had.

nodes.name: The Ferry Without Oars
nodes.lore: Before the ice, I carried people across. Now I ferry apologies. Neither ever returns.

nodes.name: Icebound Tollhouse
nodes.lore: A brass box contains toll coins polished perfectly blank.

nodes.name: Rime Watch
nodes.lore: Show me the face you wore when you entered. No substitutions.

nodes.name: Eastern Stair
nodes.lore: Frost has formed on the underside of the steps, against the wind.

nodes.name: The Unsilvered Niche
nodes.lore: One mirror has had its silver scraped away, leaving a view of bare stone.

nodes.name: The Seamstress of Faces
nodes.lore: A face is easier to mend when its owner stops moving.

nodes.name: Court of Repeated Steps
nodes.lore: Two sentries move as one. Only one leaves tracks.

nodes.name: Blackwater Basin
nodes.lore: The basin reflects an intact palace under a summer sky.

nodes.name: Threshold of True Silver
nodes.lore: Your reflection remains at the threshold after you step away.

nodes.name: Hall of Mirrors
nodes.lore: I have perfected this court. It is the world outside that refuses correction.

nodes.name: Gate of Banked Coals
nodes.lore: The gate is warm enough to hurt through a glove. No fire burns nearby.

nodes.name: The Ashen Divide
nodes.lore: Two sets of footprints separate: bare feet uphill, iron boots toward the works.

nodes.name: The Coal Tally
nodes.lore: Nothing enters empty-handed. What will you give the flame?

nodes.name: Kiln Approach
nodes.lore: Ash has settled into the shape of tools that were taken away long ago.

nodes.name: The Last Stoker
nodes.lore: We thought the heat was a blessing. Then the saint stopped asking for fuel.

nodes.name: Cold Coal Shed
nodes.lore: A sealed lunch tin sits between heaps of coal that never caught.

nodes.name: Quenching Yard
nodes.lore: A cinder mantis unfolds from a slag heap, its legs ringing against the stone.

nodes.name: Worker's Niche
nodes.lore: A small iron hand protects a candle from the furnace wind.

nodes.name: The Soot Confessor
nodes.lore: They confessed exhaustion. I called it doubt. I would like that written down.

nodes.name: The Red Stair
nodes.lore: The stair is swept clean while the surrounding terraces lie deep in ash.

nodes.name: Brazier of Petition
nodes.lore: The great brazier is cold. Its rim has melted inward.

nodes.name: Pilgrims' Stair
nodes.lore: The direct stair climbs above a fissure glowing beneath the paving.

nodes.name: Procession Landing
nodes.lore: An ember-starved pilgrim blocks the stair, guarding a coal in cupped hands.

nodes.name: Bearer of the Last Coal
nodes.lore: If it goes out, she said we all go out. Help me remember who she meant.

nodes.name: Reliquary Steps
nodes.lore: Empty reliquary sockets line the stair like missing teeth.

nodes.name: Iron Viaduct
nodes.lore: The upper works are closed. The order is old; my oath is older.

nodes.name: Eastern Abutment
nodes.lore: The iron supports sing at a pitch too low to hear clearly.

nodes.name: The Weigh House
nodes.lore: A balance hangs level with a prayer tablet on one pan and a tooth on the other.

nodes.name: Foreman Without a Shift
nodes.lore: No one dismissed us. Until someone does, the shift is not over.

nodes.name: High Works Crossing
nodes.lore: A cinder mantis has woven hot wire across the old service path.

nodes.name: The Joining Road
nodes.lore: The works road and pilgrim stair meet before the chapel terrace.

nodes.name: Chapel Forecourt
nodes.lore: Gold trim blackens above a row of names struck from the list of saints.

nodes.name: Furnace Threshold
nodes.lore: Heat presses against you like a held breath. The chains are fastened from within.

nodes.name: Furnace Chapel
nodes.lore: You call it suffering because you have not yet learned to burn clean.
